title: Session Diagnostic Record event (004 FR-017; wire-identical to 001 FR-039/FR-039b/FR-040)
description: One JSONL line per event. Event contents are kinds, positions and failure names — never document text. Trim/gap markers keep absences visible. Wire values are snake_case per crates/diag/src/writer.rs serde rename_all (Rust variants PascalCase; see diagnostic-trace.md naming note). EventKind is exactly nine kinds; 004 per-section/per-rate/buffer/latency coverage rides as data inside those kinds via detail keys, not new kinds. transport (five values) is the diag wire layer (001 FR-020 lineage), distinct from the 004 surface payload transport (playing|paused|stopped per contracts/surface.md). error (seven values) is the EngineError wire taxonomy; the 004 closed-8 product reasons map N:1 onto it per research.md R5 (DecodeFailed rides Unreachable; diag detail carries decode_failed).

engine.description: Engine identifier. With engine_tier=test_double this MUST be one of the two declared stand-ins (standin_a, standin_b) and is exempt from constitution registry resolution (lineage: 002 FR-023c/SC-057; 004 uses offline_default only).

engine_tier.description: Closed tier. Fallback order is ascending: offline_default < cloud_default < cloud_escalation < test_double < evaluated_fallback, so the Edge endpoint stays last and is never a default. test_double is admissible only while no non-test_double adapter is registered (lineage: 002 FR-024; 004 uses offline_default only).
